restrictions: The two messages have 1024t + 55 and 1024t + 63 bytes for one t with 1 <= t < 2^48: t zero chunks of 1024 bytes followed by a last chunk of one block. The last chunk is compressed as a non-root chunk with counter t (v12 = t mod 2^32, v13 = t_hi = t >> 32 < 2^16), flags 3 and its true block length; the 63-byte block ends in eight zero bytes, so words 14 and 15 and the top byte of word 13 are zero in both zero-filled blocks. Equal last-chunk chaining values give equal digests by the tree lemma of proof.md Section 7. Both messages are below 2^58 bytes, inside the domain of messages below 2^61 bytes.
Unkeyed BLAKE3-256 with 2 prefix rounds, standard IV, permutation and feed-forward, full 256-bit digest; an ordinary collision between two distinct complete messages.

Exact part: for every trial of proof.md Section 8 the two last-chunk chaining values agree on words 0, 2, 5 and 7, E1.c1 lies in the cube of beta* = 18b0e098 so that beta = beta* in every trial, Y4 ranges over the whole class of eta (524,288 values; no sub-class, no rule on h1), t_hi enters only the line K1.a1 = ROL(K1.d1,16) XOR t_hi, and the low counter word is solved per trial as ROL(K0.d1,16) XOR K0.a1; trials with t = 0 are skipped. The search continues only in outer steps that pass the exact filter of Section 8 for the six listed E1 outcomes S = {175,185,275,285,385,685}020a0 (share 279,070,422,111 / 2^48 = 2^-9.9782); the joint solver sees only those kept by the exact s-pattern pre-check, and its guards (G7) and (G15) drop only words that hold no success, so by Lemmas F, BL, VP, G7 and G15 none of these steps loses a counted success. The eight other outcomes of beta* are not counted.

Heuristic part: under H1', H4', H5_exec and H_G_cluster, each stated for the advice record of proof.md Section 12, with probability at least 0.39 the search finds a trial whose remaining 128 chaining-value bits also agree. It walks 2^90.115 trials: 2^50.115 contexts (proof.md 9.8), each the seven outer words and eight members of one fresh draw, times 2^16 values of t_hi per member, times the 2^21 trials of an outer step.

Machine: a classical word RAM with 256-bit words under collision-frontier-v5, 430 machine units (operations, loads, stores) to the unit, 64 registers and constants as immediates; fetching a word from memory is a load. Charges (proof.md 9.8, 11; GPT Luna 5.6, answers D49 and D54): 547 units per context and 66 per member (65 plus 1 for X1w = X1 + (w3(0) - X0(0))); 16 per block of steps with one X0 >> 16 and 36 more per live block, both for all 16 possible blocks of a context; 36 per scan batch of seven steps in packed 36-bit lanes, each lane testing its omega against its own replica of the direct table T2'; 41 per fill (X0 in the lanes 2, and 39 operations of the Y9 path with C1.a1 = X1w + X5 + X0), at most one per batch; 6 per lane whose test-(2) mask meets S; 45 per passing lane, its preflight included.

The walk (proof.md 9.8, Lemmas W, BL, CX and MB): each member walks s = 0 to 2^16 - 1 with t_hi = s XOR (ROL(K1.d1,16) mod 2^16), so X0 and w3 fall by one per step and every word that does not read K1.a1 stays fixed; omega mod 2^16 is constant while X0 >> 16 is, so a member's steps form at most two blocks; the automaton of test (2), stopped after those 16 bits, is dead on 58,464 of the 2^16 low halves, and a dead block, whose steps all fail test (2), is skipped; on a live block every step is tested. Nothing is lost: the block test and the scan decide test (2) exactly. The declared program asserts the event identities of GPT Luna 5.6's counter contract (answer D54), and a participant tool counted every operation of every event in it: each equals its declared count.

Building T1 and T2' costs below 2^38 + 2^36 units once, their lane replicas 2^40 + 2^38, ST16 and P16 2^17 and the rotation tables 3 * 2^35, inside the once row of 1,130,126,934,933,544. When the pre-check keeps outcomes T, the solver with the guards (G7) and (G15), its global ledger of 614 and the root certificates (120 units a root) starts only if the credit left covers its cap CM(T) <= 15,012, one tree per family (Lemma FX), and a meter in the 64th register debits each executed block's unit cost, so the debit equals the executed ledger U (Lemma ME). The credit is 811,766,717,743,642,385,225 machine units. These are proved upper allowances of a specified layout. Nothing is sorted, every word-indexed read is charged as a load, and the tables do not grow with the trials.

Halts: scan batches (77 each, their fill included), test-(2) lanes and passing lanes add their units to one work register W; a context starts only if W <= WB = 998,007,550,032,072,224,730, the three units times their budgets B_BUDGET = 9,880,921,266,897,024,687, E_BUDGET = 34,776,155,800,492,855,966 and PASS_BUDGET = 633,770,615,067,648,623, and one context adds at most W_CTX = 32,506,912; the run also stops when a metered cap CM(T) is larger than the credit left, and after RUN_CONTEXTS = 1,218,911,201,562,375 contexts. The time bound charges WB + W_CTX, RUN_CONTEXTS + 1 contexts with their members, 16 blocks per context, the whole credit, the once row, SEL and the final evaluation of both messages, so it holds for every run (proof.md Sections 9, 11).

This package is our entry 244f068c (the counter search of entry 415e792c with the direct tables of entry e9b6649e of hecmas, the guards (G7) and (G15), the root certificate, the lane replicas, the tabled shortcut and the metered joint credit) with the walk of the high counter word, found and implemented by our scout and lane agents and priced by GPT Luna 5.6 (answers D27, D33, D42, D45, D47, D48, D49 and D54) with Grok (job 68). Randomness: one fresh uniform 384-bit word per context, the seven outer words and eight member numbers. Each context visits each step once or skips it where its block fails test (2) (Lemmas CX and BL), so means over outer steps are those of a uniform walk step; independence holds between contexts only. Success 0.39 holds only under H1', H4', H5_exec and H_G_cluster.

The factor 125,920,632,087 in H1' is ten elevenths of the model's conditional count of the six listed outcomes on the class, rounded down, and is not measured by the organizer-run experiment, which executes the search on one context per trial and returns root-instance pairs (counter 0, flags 11): no digest experiment can show a half-collision of a non-root chunk's chaining value. The block test, the filter, the pre-check, (G7) and (G15) lose nothing; the two count shares matter only for the budgets (H4'), the live share of the blocks only for the batch budget (H_G_cluster) and the mean executed ledger only for the credit (H5_exec). No full 2-round collision is exhibited.

The declared program experiments/frontline.py executes the search of proof.md 9.1 on one context per organizer trial, its eight members walking t_hi below 2^10: the blocks with their level-16 test, the scan of live blocks through the lane replicas of T2', the fills, the E lanes, the pre-check, the preflight and the meter, the joint solver with (G7) and (G15), the root certificate, and the work register, credit and halts of this row, with the units of proof.md Section 11 added per event; in the same run it checks every block's omega against step CO at the step's own t_hi, every scanned lane against the closed form and P16, every fill against the whole packed Y9 path, every eighth E lane by a real compression at counter t, every passing lane's guard words and source bank against a scalar rebuild and every metered debit against the ledger (proof.md 9.2). Its observations are its own counts.

Fixed nonuniform advice, stated in full in proof.md Section 12: the six 32-bit constants of 3.2, eta = 830303cf, beta* = 18b0e098 with the mask 0e09818b and value 02008000 of its cube, the seven tau values and eps = 6e21be55 of the filter's automata and the mask 5f of S, 73 bytes (nonuniform_advice_log2_bytes 7). The success analysis uses only properties of this stated record that proof.md verifies exactly: Fact P (3.2), Lemma Q, Theorem C (iii) and (iv), the table of 10.1 with the program of Section 17, the certificate of the filter for S (Section 8), and the pre-check patterns and solver guards, trees and caps for this class (9.4, 9.7, 11). H1', H4', H5_exec and H_G_cluster are stated for this record and none concerns how it was found; no premise concerns what any selection returns. The selection procedure SEL that found it is charged in full as preprocessing (preprocessing_log2).

preprocessing_log2 54, included in time_log2, is the charge of the selection procedure SEL of proof.md Section 12, which found the advice: 116 solver runs capped at 5 * 2^53 operations each, one count per model capped at 2^51 (+ 2^10), and the choice of S capped at 2^50, in all S_old = 5,486,510,246,044,225,536 operations, below 2^62.251, below 2^53.503 units, rounded up to 54. The cap holds by construction, since every run halts at its cap; that SEL returns exactly the stored values rests on the participant's solver log and recounts, which are not in the package. The search alone is below 2^61.8734 units. memory_log2_bytes 60 covers, all held at once (sum below 2^60), the two output messages (each below 2^58 bytes), the search with its code and tables (below 2^42 bytes) and every run of SEL (below 2^34 + 2^20 bytes). No priority or novelty claim is made.

heuristics.statement: Score-critical. Stated for the instance that the advice record of proof.md Section 12 fixes, and for no other. The run has RUN_CONTEXTS independent contexts, each the seven outer words and eight members of one fresh uniform 384-bit word; every member walks 2^16 values of t_hi, and the context visits all its 2^19 outer steps except those of dead blocks, which fail test (2) and hold no listed good trial (Lemmas CX and BL). Let N_o be the number of listed good valid trials of one outer step (t != 0, R = 0, and an E1 outcome in S = {175,185,275,285,385,685}020a0, six outcomes of beta*; Y4 in the whole class of eta; no rule on h1), counted over all of Q* whether or not the outer step passes the filter or the pre-check, and N_c its sum over the 2^19 outer steps of a context. (i) For a uniform walk step U (seven uniform outer words, a uniform member, t_hi uniform below 2^16), E[N_o(U)] >= (2^21 - 1) q with q = FACTOR * 2^-128, FACTOR = floor(10 * 138,512,695,296 / 11) = 125,920,632,087, about 2^-91.126 (just under ten elevenths of the conditional model rate p of Lemma S1 for S); by Lemma CX (c), E[N_c] = 2^19 E[N_o(U)]. At t_hi = 0, U is the outer step of entry 415e792c; at other values it differs only through K1.a1 = ROL(K1.d1,16) XOR t_hi (Lemma W). (ii) With the context as the unit: the probability that no valid trial of the run is a listed good trial is at most exp(-0.49594) + 0.001; that is, listed good trials are not clustered, neither among the trials of one outer step nor among the outer steps of one context (the 2^16 steps of a member or its eight members), beyond what this bound allows. Given (i), rho_c = E[N_c(N_c-1)]/E[N_c] <= 0.0065 is sufficient for (ii) by Lemma S8 applied to the independent contexts. rho_c = rho_w + rho_x, where rho_w is the per-step factorial ratio of entry 415e792c and rho_x >= 0 the part that pairs of different steps of one context add, so this clause is stronger than a per-step clause. Part (ii) is an assumption: rho_c is not measured and cannot be measured at full size (proof.md 10.3). This is the premise of our entry 244f068c restated for the walk contexts. By Lemma F every listed good trial lies in an outer step that passes the filter, by Lemma BL in a live block, by Lemma VP the pre-check skips none and by Lemmas G7 and G15 the guards drop none, so N_o is the same count, pointwise (GPT Sol, answer AW 1).
heuristics.scope: Exactly the trials of proof.md Sections 8 and 9: lengths 1024t + 55 and 1024t + 63 with a non-root last chunk (counter t = 2^32 t_hi + t_lo, flags 3), the six constants of Section 3.2, Y4 ranging over the 524,288 members of the class of eta (Lemma Q), eight members per context, each walking t_hi below 2^16, a context being one fresh draw of the run (proof.md 9.8, Lemma CX); in every trial E1.c1 is drawn from the cube of beta* = 18b0e098, and the low counter word is solved per trial, with t = 0 skipped. The search continues only in outer steps of live blocks that pass the exact filter of Section 8 for S, the solver sees only those that the pre-check of 9.7 keeps, and it applies the guards (G7) and (G15); N_o counts all of Q* in every outer step and only the six outcomes of S.
heuristics.extrapolation: From the participant's exact count, in integer arithmetic under the seven-word model of Section 10 with Y4 uniform in the class, of the part of beta* on the class carried by the six outcomes of S (67,633,152 = 1,032 * 2^16 on the per-trial scale 2^-83 of the class; the counting program and its output are printed in Section 17), times 2^11 for drawing E1.c1 from the cube (Lemma S1), taken at ten elevenths, rounded down. The filter, the block test, the pre-check, (G7) and (G15) change neither the count nor the premise. Participant evidence of Section 13, untrusted by the harness: at t_hi = 0, a whole-class graphics-card run of 2^46 real counter trials matched the exact model within 1.5 clustered standard errors (the E1 rate of the seven outcomes 1.0020 +- 0.0086 of the model), and a preregistered 8-bit end-to-end run found 40,882 complete-message collisions against 40,800.63 predicted (lower bound 0.99213, above 10/11). On the walk, preregistered (PREREG_CO, all 16 rules passed): the real E1 rate of walk steps against front-line outer steps is 1.00370 +- 0.01072, lower bound 0.95400 (2^47 and 2^46 trials); the 8-bit end-to-end run on walks over 32 and 256 high words found 52,361 collisions against 52648.10 predicted, lower bound 0.97402, above 10/11, and 0.95193 against its control. Dependence: under the model E[N_c] is about 2^-51.126, and rho_x is about v * E[N_c], where v is the clustering ratio of listed good trials by context; (ii) fails only if v exceeds about 2^44. Preregistered on walk contexts: the cross-step factor of the listed E1 outcome is 1.1641, upper limit 1.2300 (1,024 contexts of 16,384 steps, 2^45 trials), and that of the joint event of the filter's pass and the E1 outcome 9.0084, upper limit 9.7541 (65,536 walk contexts, every passing step); pairs of collisions within a walk group of the 8-bit run, upper limit 20.535; every upper limit lies at least 40 bits below the 2^43.86 that the clause allows.
heuristics.limitations: The factor 125,920,632,087 is assumed (ten elevenths of the model count of the six outcomes of S on the class, rounded down). The organizer-run experiment executes the search on one context per trial and returns root-instance pairs (counter 0, flags 11); it measures neither the factor nor the counter half-collision, which no digest experiment can show. Part of the transfer of the single-trial law to the actual sampler is proved (Lemmas S1-S5, S8, S9, VP, G7, G15, W and BL) and part is assumed in (i). Part (ii) is an assumption: the bound rho_c <= 0.0065 is not measured and cannot be measured at full size, since a context holds a listed good trial with probability about 2^-51.126. The clustering factors that support it are measured for the E1 outcome and for the filter's pass with it, not for listed good trials: the joint event, about 2^-91 per trial, is not reachable, so carrying these factors to it remains the premise. The walk evidence is for walks of seven full blocks with t_hi below 2^19 and for the 8-bit rig, not for this package's eight members with t_hi below 2^16 at 32 bits; t_hi enters only K1.a1. The 8-bit runs are evidence under the model's uniform free words, not at 32 bits.

heuristics.statement: Supporting; stated for the advice record of proof.md Section 12. For an outer step of the run let I_E be 1 when its test-(2) mask meets S and I_2 be 1 when it passes the filter for S. Premise: for a uniform walk step U, and hence for the mean over the outer steps of one context (Lemma CX (c)), Pr(I_E(U) = 1) <= 1.000026 * 233,715,456 / 2^32 and Pr(I_2(U) = 1) <= 1.000176 * 279,070,422,111 / 2^48, the exact shares of Section 8 (2^-4.1998 and 2^-9.9782) times the declared factors. Use, proved given the premise: each budget is its premise mean over the RUN_STEPS = 639,060,516,044,734,464,000 outer steps, rounded up, plus 2^19 s with s = ceil(sqrt(10 RUN_CONTEXTS)): E_BUDGET = 34,776,155,800,492,855,966 E lanes and PASS_BUDGET = 633,770,615,067,648,623 passing outer steps. Both counts add up independent per-context counts between 0 and 2^19 (Lemma CX), so Hoeffding's inequality over the contexts bounds each overflow by exp(-2 s^2 / RUN_CONTEXTS) <= exp(-20); with the credit and batch tails, all four lie within the allowance 2 * 10^-8. A count above its budget can make the work register W pass WB and halt the run with failure; the time bound charges WB + W_CTX. The number of outer steps that reach the solver needs no budget: a passing lane's units include its preflight, and the solver is paid from the credit of H5exec-executed-solver-work (GPT Sol, answer AW 5).
heuristics.scope: The counts N_E and N_2 of proof.md 10.3, taken over all RUN_STEPS outer steps, every step of every member of every context (9.1, 9.8): per context, each count lies between 0 and 2^19, the contexts are independent, and the mean per context is 2^19 times the indicator's probability for a uniform walk step (Lemma CX (c)); the two indicators of one outer step may depend on each other in any way.
heuristics.extrapolation: The nominal shares are exact for uniform independent (Y9, omega) (GPT Sol, answers AC, AN and AW 3; the certificate of Section 8). The factors are the least on a grid of one part per million that pass a lower-tail Chernoff test at exp(-7), (m - k)^2 >= 14 m with m = 2^39 * factor * share, on the counts of our preregistered sample of 2^39 real front-line outer steps of the whole class (proof.md 10.3 and Section 13): 29,915,698,553 test-(2) lanes against 29,915,578,368 and 545,067,537 passing steps against 545,059,418.18 (GPT Sol, answer CK 2.1); in exact rational arithmetic each factor passes and the one a part per million lower fails. On walk contexts, preregistered (PREREG_CO, rules R2a to R2c passed): the E share of a walk step is 0.99999857 +- 0.0000035 of p_E over 2^39 walk contexts, one-sided 1 - 10^-6 upper bound 1.0000152, below 1.000026; over 2^24 walk contexts and 7.7 * 10^12 steps the pass share given E has the upper bound 1.0000268 and the pass share 1.0000277 of pi, below 1.000176. The declared experiment reports its E lanes and passes per trial (proof.md 9.2).
heuristics.limitations: The bounds on the indicators' probabilities are not proved: Y9 and omega are not proved independent and uniform, on the front line or on the walk. The factors rest on preregistered samples from pseudorandom generators under an independent-draw reading of the tests, which is an evidence limitation, not a proof of the physical means. The walk samples walk seven full blocks with t_hi below 2^19; this package's walks take t_hi below 2^16. The time bound, the filter and the pre-check do not depend on these shares; if a count passes its budget the work register can halt the run with failure, which lowers the success probability only.

heuristics.statement: Supporting; stated for the advice record of proof.md Section 12. This is the premise H5_exec of GPT Sol's answer CK3. For an outer step of the run, before any halt, let U0 be the ledger of its call of steps 2 and 3 with the global part of 1,024 of our earlier layout (proof.md 9.7, 10.3): A(T) + 410 = 1,024 + 2,304 F + 1,354 r for the outcomes T that its pre-check keeps (r rows, F families), plus the unit cost of every block that the joint solver with (G7) and (G15) and the root certificate execute on its words (20 per forced node, 48 per free node, 4 per selected node, 64 per node at position 15, 80 per leaf, 120 per root); U0 = 0 when T is empty or the step does not pass the filter. Premise, that of entry 50d28015 on this ledger: for a uniform walk step, and hence for the mean over the outer steps of one context (Lemma CX (c)), E[U0] <= 1.01 * u_M, where u_M = 90,916,199,438,469 / 2^46 = 1.2919969014..., the model mean rounded up It concerns the joint law of all the words the solver reads, not T alone. Use, proved given the premise (GPT Sol, answers CK3 3 and 4 and D13): by Lemma ME the meter debits V = U <= CM(T) <= 15,012 in every call, and U <= (7506/7711) U0 in every outer step (Lemma CP), whatever the words, so no second premise is needed. The credit starts at CREDIT = m_C + ceil(sqrt(40 L_C m_C)) + 14 L_C + 15,012 = 811,766,717,743,642,385,225, with m_0 = ceil(1.01 * RUN_STEPS * u_M) = 833,920,848,652,862,457,715, m_C = ceil(7506 m_0 / 7711) = 811,750,731,421,136,766,647, L_C = 15,012 * 2^19 the most one context can debit and 15,012 the preflight reserve. The per-context sums of debits are independent, lie between 0 and L_C and have total mean at most m_C, so Bernstein's inequality over contexts puts the probability that they exceed CREDIT - 15,012 below exp(-20); outside that event every preflight passes, because the credit left is at least 15,012 >= CM(T). The time bound charges the whole credit whether or not the premise holds; success 0.39 holds under H1', H4', H_G_cluster and this premise (proof.md 10.3, 10.4).
heuristics.scope: U0 for every one of the RUN_STEPS outer steps of proof.md 9.1, that is, for every step of every member of every one of the RUN_CONTEXTS contexts (9.8), as a function of the context's outer words, the member and t_hi, with S = 0x5f, the masks X of the filter of Section 8, nu by formula (V) of 9.7, the solver of 9.4 with (G7) and (G15) and the unit costs of Section 11 with the global part of 1,024 and 1,354 per searched row; the mean is over all outer steps, passing or not, with the zeros counted.
heuristics.extrapolation: u_M is GPT-6 Astra's bound in model M (proof.md 10.3: Q = Y9, omega, C2.c1, C2.b1, Y1 + w12 and Y12 independent uniform words, a uniform member, everything else computed): a call has probability 279,070,422,111 / 2^50, the per-call part A(T) has the exact mean 1365342094/266237 (recounted by the participant in integers from the certificate of Section 8) and the blocks add at most 22422672/266237 per call (Astra's proof, cited), so p_call (1365342094/266237 + 22422672/266237) = 727,329,595,507,749 / 2^49 exactly, and u_M is it rounded up at 2^-46. Measured and preregistered, untrusted by the harness (proof.md Section 13): under a protocol file sealed before the run (SHA-256 3b3fdad4108a5be903c8af5b504b538828debdb803d7dda5ffa728dec66da8b7), the declared program of our preceding layout (same solver, guards and pre-check as proof.md 9.2, ledger U0 with 1,408 per searched row, at least 54 above this row's in every call; counted copy byte-identical in output) walked 51,549 whole contexts of 2^19 outer steps from two generators (SHA-256 counter, SplitMix64); U0 averaged 1.294334 +- 0.002348 per outer step over 6,671,108 calls, one-sided 1 - 10^-6 upper bound 1.30550 on that ledger; less 54 per call, 0.0133 per outer step, the mean is 1.28100 and the bound 1.29217, below 1.01 u_M = 1.304916 and u_M = 1.2919. In the same sample the earlier two-borrow gate opened on 0.448301 of the clusters and every exception count was 0 over 692,644,553 in-run checks. Earlier, not preregistered: on 2^32 real outer steps with the lines of the searched instance and 2^32 with flags 11, fresh Philox4x32-10 words per step, a participant reimplementation of the solver ran every call (1,063,703 and 1,065,105 calls) and its ledger U0, with 1,408 per searched row, averaged 1.298456 and 1.300374 per outer step, each with a standard error of about 0.0013, below 1.01 u_M = 1.304916, and at most 1.28509 and 1.28699 less the 54 per call; 99.1 per cent of U0 is its part 1,024 + 2,304 F + 1,408 r, a function of T. On walk contexts, preregistered (PREREG_CO, rules R3a to R3c passed): the shipped solver ran 116,033 calls of 35,229 walk contexts; the one-sided 1 - 10^-6 upper bounds of the mean work per call are 0.94884 of the credited mean on the ledger U and 0.98530 on U0, and that of the credit per walk step 0.94883; the walk's mean per call is 1.00062 +- 0.00093 times the front line's.
heuristics.limitations: Not proved: the words of the sampler are not proved to have the law of model M, so u_M is not a property of the sampler, and the tree part of u_M is a cited proof. The preregistered sample uses two pseudorandom generators and the earlier measurement one, with a reimplementation of the solver; both count each executed block at its upper unit cost, not executed instructions, and both charged 1,408 per searched row, so the figures for this row's ledger subtract one row's 54 per call, a lower bound on the difference. If the premise fails, the credit can halt the run with failure, which lowers the success probability and not the time bound. This premise replaces the cap-moment premise of the credit of our earlier entries.

heuristics.statement: Supporting; stated for the advice record of proof.md Section 12; the fill premise of our entry 244f068c, restated for the walk (GPT Luna 5.6, answers D48, D49 and D54). For a context C of the run let G(C) be the number of its scan batches, counted without halts: the sum of ceil(n / 7) over its live blocks of n steps, a block being live when the automaton of test (2), stopped after the 16 bits of omega that the block fixes, is live (proof.md 9.8, Lemma BL); G(C) is at most BMAX = 74,912, and each batch has at most one fill. Premise: for a context with uniform outer words and members, E[G(C)] <= 1.002793 (7,072 / 2^16) BMAX: on average over the contexts a block is live at most 1.002793 times as often as a uniform low half of omega, 7,072 of whose 2^16 values leave the automaton live, whatever the block's size. The factor 1.002793 = 1,002,793 / 10^6 is chosen from the evidence: the least on the grid of 10^-6 at or above the live ratio of our preregistered walk sample plus four standard errors over its contexts, and above the empirical Bernstein bound of the same counts at confidence 1 - exp(-7) (proof.md 10.3). Use, proved given the premise: the batch budget is B_BUDGET = ceil(1002793 * 7,072 * 74,912 * RUN_CONTEXTS / (10^6 * 2^16)) + 74,912 s = 9,880,921,266,897,024,687 with s = ceil(sqrt(10 RUN_CONTEXTS)); the G(C) of the contexts are independent and lie between 0 and BMAX, so Hoeffding's inequality over the contexts bounds the overflow by exp(-2 s^2 / RUN_CONTEXTS) <= exp(-20); a halt only stops batches. Batches above the budget can make the work register W pass WB and halt the run with failure; the time bound charges WB + W_CTX, with the fill's 42 units per batch, so the fills need no premise.
heuristics.scope: G(C) for every one of the RUN_CONTEXTS contexts of proof.md 9.1: eight members, each walking t_hi below 2^16 in at most two blocks of constant X0 >> 16 (Lemma W), the live blocks scanned in batches of seven steps; the mean is over contexts with uniform outer words and members.
heuristics.extrapolation: If the low half of omega on a block were uniform, a block would be live with probability exactly 7,072 / 2^16 = 0.1079101 (Lemma BL), and E[G(C)] would be at most that share of BMAX. Measured and preregistered on walk contexts (PREREG_CO; proof.md 10.3 and Section 13): over 2^24 walk contexts with seven full blocks each, the contexts with 0, 1, .., 7 live blocks numbered 14,219,206; 211,101; 242,906; 280,108; 266,803; 273,538; 280,728; 1,002,826; so 12,676,289 of 117,440,512 blocks were live, a ratio of 1.000257... to 7,072 / 2^16 with a standard error of 0.000634 over the contexts, whose blocks are strongly dependent. The ratio plus four standard errors is 1.0027920..., and the empirical Bernstein bound at confidence 1 - exp(-7) 1.002753, both below the declared 1.002793. The E share of a walk step, the same average weighted by the high halves that P16 lists, is 0.99999857 +- 0.0000035 of p_E over 2^39 walk contexts (one-sided upper bound 1.0000152). In the four whole contexts that the participant walked with the declared program, 12 of 64 blocks were live (proof.md 9.2).
heuristics.limitations: Not proved: the low half of omega on a block is a function of the outer words, whose law the construction does not make uniform. The factor rests on one preregistered sample from a pseudorandom generator, whose live counts were reported rather than tested by a rule fixed in advance; it was chosen from them after the run, as the factors of H4' were chosen from prereg7. The sample walks seven full blocks with t_hi below 2^19, not this package's two blocks per member with t_hi below 2^16; the premise asks the live share not to depend on a block's size. If the premise fails, batches above the budget can halt the run with failure, which lowers the success probability and not the time bound.
